scope: Oito concepts adultos independentes com lore proposta; sem integração ou novas pré-evoluções.

members.name: Geordraco
members.lore: Recusa provar coragem matando o que foi ferido. Sua lança prende linhas hostis e o escudo abre uma saída; se insistir em perseguir, abandona quem protegia.
members.spec: MALE KNIGHT, stocky heroic barrel chest, broad planted stance, enormous shield silhouette on left. EMERALD green lacquer-metal armor, ivory paper body, bright coral-red cape lining, brass details; eyes deep VIOLET. Dragon skull helmet SHORT forward brow with side-curled horns, closed ivory knight visor and emerald crown. ONE long bamboo-reinforced lance in right hand angled OUTWARD, tip shaped forked ivory jaw (no drill cone); left hand grips a tall asymmetrical kite-shield with metallic dragon FACE relief as whole upper shield, nostril grooves and closed metal jaws, emerald/ivory fields. Shoulder plates contain subtle smaller dragon brow relief, knees simpler. Compact layered thigh plates and heavy feet, powerful mature proportions, no long skinny limbs. ONE complete braided coral rabiola rooted behind waist and ivory/coral split flag, separate from a short heavy green cape. Poised protective forward step, lance and shield never obscure head.

members.name: Lacustrel
members.lore: Carrega dois juramentos incompatíveis e precisa escolher a quem proteger. Sua espada abre um corredor entre linhas cruzadas, mas não permite defender as duas margens sozinho.
members.spec: MALE KNIGHT, tall broadshouldered elegant lake duelist, long but robust mature torso and thighs, controlled sword stance. DEEP COBALT and silver metal armor with TURQUOISE paper underbody and lilac cape lining, small mint-green visor light. Helmet upper dragon skull has two lateral fin-like crests swept backward and short snout ridge, lower full CLOSED silver visor with dark central seam. TWO shoulder pauldrons are smooth METALLIC river-dragon faces elongated sideways, quiet broad silver chest with a blue V like two lake banks, no jewel. Holds ONE wide long straight translucent-appearing but FLAT ivory/cyan PAPER-LINE greatsword in BOTH hands, hands far apart on one grip, blade diagonal outward and uncropped; split bamboo framing and two thin tension cords explain blade, no second weapon. Waist has two overlapping broad kite coat tails, knees smooth, boots large. ONE blue-silver braided rabiola rooted rear pelvis with twin lilac pennants, distinct from coat. Adult oath-burdened calm, no gigantic cone lance or circular shield.

members.name: Valdrisa
members.lore: Escolhe voltar por quem perdeu a própria linha. As velas dorsais sustentam uma retirada breve, mas não carregam toda a formação de uma vez.
members.spec: FEMALE adult DRAGON KNIGHT, athletic powerful hourglass armored torso natural proportions, broad thighs and secure boots, NO exposed skin or sexualized armor. PALE ICE-CYAN, dark plum and steel-silver armor, warm GOLD kite spars, white paper membranes, tiny deep blue visor eyes. Helmet short draconic brow skull with TWO swept dragon EAR-FINS resembling folded feather fans, NOT bird wings; CLOSED layered silver beakless knight jaw visor. Two HUGE upper shoulder guards are silver dragon masks with curved short horns; paired dorsal rescue SAILS form open crescent fans with three broad ivory/cyan panels each, no feather texture. Holds ONE large halberd diagonally in right hand, crescent-hooked blade like a dragon lower jaw; left hand open reaching down to help, both arms complete. Single small rescue loop fixed at belt, not floating. ONE braided white/plum soul-rabiola rooted waist with three cyan lozenge pennants. Wide steady guardian stance, not airborne so feet clear. Distinct wide upper fan silhouette.

members.name: Joanacendra
members.lore: Não escuta ordens do destino: reconhece as linhas de parceiros dispersos e ergue um estandarte para reuni-los. Sua força exige permanecer visível, expondo sua posição.
members.spec: FEMALE adult dragon banner KNIGHT, strong compact torso and sturdy legs, severe grounded commander shape, full practical armor no bare skin. PEARL WHITE/silver metal with smoky CHARCOAL broad chest plates, vivid MAGENTA paper underfolds and warm brass joints, small teal eye slit. Upper dragon-skull helmet broad low brow and very small two rear swept horns; closed silver lattice-jaw visor, no open face or hair. Broad breastplate is ONE embossed METALLIC dragon face centered on sternum, shoulder guards relatively modest so chest is focal; articulated waist and large knees. Carries ONE tall continuous bamboo bannerstaff in right hand, massive asymmetrical TAUT paper flag in white/magenta with ONE original flame-knot graphic no text or real heraldry, uncropped; left hand rests open on chest, not another weapon. Short charred-edge dark cape has only three big clean torn shapes, not noisy shredded cloth. ONE braided magenta soul-rabiola rooted back waist ends in small ivory flame fan, separate from flag. Stance rallying forward, adult solemn authoritative, small helmet over robust chest.

members.name: Cidraco
members.lore: A fama o precede, mas ele protege viajantes que não reconhecem seu brasão. Aprende a abandonar a vitória espetacular para manter uma travessia segura.
members.spec: MALE adult DRAGON KNIGHT, heavily built older veteran tank with square chest, thick arms and short powerful legs, not slim. BURNT SAFFRON, rich OXBLOOD and aged silver armor, charcoal living-paper underbody and emerald tiny visor eyes, no orange eyes. Closed helmet has broad low draconic skull brow and short curling side horns framing knight cheek/visor, full lower layered silver mask, mature stern. LEFT shoulder is one massive sculpted metallic dragon HEAD-face pauldron in silver/oxblood, RIGHT shoulder smaller, BOTH knees have blunt miniature dragonface relief, chest broad quiet saffron planes. One curved SINGLE-EDGE fantasy sabre held outward in right hand and small HEXAGONAL kite buckler in left with paper star-fold geometry (no religious symbols), no extra weapons. Short thick oxblood cape flows behind one leg, decorative bamboo edge ribs and anchored knots, no fur beard. ONE heavy ochre/saffron braided rabiola rooted rear waist ends oxblood caravan pennant. Grounded escort stance, all hands feet visible, not mounted or centaur.

members.name: Tomoeryu
members.nature: Figura semihistórica da tradição guerreira japonesa
members.lore: Defende a retaguarda com curvas de linha em vez de golpes frontais. A lâmina desvia uma carga por vez; tentar deter todas rompe sua postura.
members.spec: FEMALE adult draconic NAGINATA knight, sturdy athletic hips and strong legs, elegant compact upper body, full armor no skin. INK NAVY and vivid CORAL-red armor with ivory living-paper membranes, jade-green small visor slit and brass knot rivets. Helmet combines short DRAGON SKULL upper crest with TWO broad antler-like bamboo side arcs (ONLY two smooth arcs, not branch forest), full closed layered SILVER lower knight visor no human face, no samurai moustache. Broad right shoulder laminated guard sculpted as a metallic long river-dragon FACE; layered skirt made of FIVE broad paper-and-lacquer plates, left shoulder lighter and ONE dragonface knee. Holds ONE long continuous naginata in BOTH hands, curved blade ivory/silver with red edge and ONE small navy tension sail at root, all fingers/grip coherent, no second staff or sword. Short angular two-panel coral back sash not wings. ONE thin navy braided soul-rabiola rooted back waist with forked coral terminal distinct from weapon ties. Lateral pivot defensive pose on TWO firmly planted boots; look toward blade, mature disciplined authority.

members.name: Bradamara
members.lore: Quebra os fechos que aprisionam outras almáticas. Seu golpe só deve atingir a amarra: força sem precisão machuca o corpo que pretende libertar.
members.spec: FEMALE adult dragon breaker KNIGHT, compact very muscular armored build expressed by wide chest and strong thighs (not bare muscles), powerful stable stance. rich AMETHYST purple, pale GOLD and ivory armor, mint green living-paper recessed joints, violet-pink tiny visor slit. Helmet upper dragon skull angular long swept eyebrow plates, two short backward horns, CLOSED ivory knight lower visor with overlapping curved jaw scales. LARGE gold dragonface relief on EACH shoulder forming two blunt closed-jaw faces, forearm cuffs broad and few articulated plates, torso has quiet purple breastplate with off-center gold binding stripe no crystal. Holds ONE HUGE two-handed fantasy WAR HAMMER: long bamboo-latticed shaft in both hands, HAMMERHEAD a broad rectangular-crescent metallized dragon JAW block with two smooth closed fang edges and a taut lilac kite face center, no real spikes forest. Weapon resting tilted in front, both hands visible, feet spread. Three broad gold-edged purple kite skirt panels, ONE braided mint/gold rabiola rooted rear waist with lilac butterfly-fan terminal. Feminine mature identity via proportions and gesture, NOT sexy armor, no stilettos or exposed breasts.

members.name: Rolandor
members.lore: Seu erro antigo foi chamar ajuda tarde demais. Agora prefere soar o alerta antes de exibir coragem, e sustenta a linha até o último aliado atravessar.
members.spec: MALE adult DRAGON KNIGHT, very tall massively broad shoulders and deep chest, sturdy long legs but not thin, full-body upright last-stand stance. DARK FOREST GREEN and STEEL SILVER heavy armor with crimson folded-paper underlayers, small icy BLUE eye slit. Upper helmet dragon skull blunt front brow and two swept horizontal chisel horns, CLOSED silver layered knight visor jaw, no human face or exposed mouth. TWO HUGE silver pauldrons are distinct metallic snarling dragon-face reliefs with SHUT sculpted jaws, central forest green breastplate broad and simple, strong overlapping shin armor. Right hand holds ONE broad straight greatsword point down to ground at side, fully visible hand and blade; LEFT hand lifts ONE short curved ceremonial SIGNAL HORN in silver/crimson toward helmet side, horn is not connected to face, no trumpet mouth fusion. Horn surface has simplified dragon brow relief and paper bell membrane. Split dark green cape broad only two panels, ONE rooted crimson braided soul-rabiola with three silver alert pennants. Mature authoritative posture, no giant wings, no hammer or lance, quiet armor between focal relief.
